turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on the past simple with -ed?
turns.tutor:
You asked about the past with -ed. Quick reminder: we use the past for actions that are finished.
Worked example: Now I clean the kitchen. Last night? Clean is a regular verb, so I add -ed: Last night I cleaned the kitchen.
The rule: add -ed to a regular verb to show a finished action.
Right: They visited their friends. Wrong: They visit their friends last week.
Now you: Yesterday my sister ___ (wash) the car.
